description: Look up a product by id (from list_products) and explain exactly how to buy it: its price, and the x402 purchase flow step by step (the 402 challenge shape, the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, and the signed download URL you get back on success). Does not take payment itself — informational only, mirroring the pre-payment leg of GET /v1/buy/:id.
name: get_purchase_info
title: Get Purchase Info
